text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О seems tired, so I suggest
we go for
a walk. Soon enough, we're
stopped by a few
fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Thank you for your gracious
support! I shall
return all your favor
with... an opera of gratitude!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... D-did you see their beaming faces? My brilliance has come through once again!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list:
Isn't it exhausting to perform an opera each
time you want to thank your fans?

text_block_list.text:
Noblesse oblige. Even in the most
inclement of
weather, the sun must rise
to bring light to the
world.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
On top of her races, her efforts to please
her fans
are taking a toll on her. Maybe I
should adjust her
racing schedule.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
